[d2] (Britannica) states it was "completed in 957 bce," while [d9] argues through biblical and classical chronology that construction began in 967 BCE, and [d7] places it "between the fourth and eleventh years of his reign (ca. 950 BCE)." In sum, while most sources agree the First Temple was built by Solomon sometime in the 10th century BCE, the exact date remains a matter of scholarly disagreement, with proposed dates ranging from approximately 1000 BC to 957 BCE.
